# Aurico Alloys LLP

> Stockist, manufacturer and exporter of nickel alloys, titanium, duplex and
> stainless steel, and cobalt alloys, held ex-stock in Mumbai, India and shipped
> worldwide. Material is supplied as sheet, plate, bar, coil, foil, wire, strip,
> pipe, tube and fittings, cut to size, with EN 10204 3.1 mill test certificates.

Aurico Alloys LLP is an ISO 9001:2015 certified supplier based at 112, 1st Floor,
Aman Grih, Carpenter 1st Street, C.P. Tank, Mumbai 400004, Maharashtra, India.
Contact: info@auricoalloys.com, +91 79778 86611. Exports to more than 40 countries.

Pricing is quotation-based and depends on grade, form, dimensions and quantity;
no list prices are published on the site. Product pages carry the UNS number,
Werkstoff (W.Nr.) number, applicable ASTM/ASME specifications, chemistry ranges,
mechanical properties and the stocked size envelope for that grade and form.

## Alloy families

- [Inconel](https://www.nickelsheets.com/inconel/): nickel-chromium superalloys — 600, 601, 617, 625, 625 LCF, 686, 690, 693, 718, 725, 740H, 751, 783, X-750
- [Alloy 602 CA](https://www.nickelsheets.com/nickel-alloy/602-CA/): UNS N06025 / 2.4633, a VDM Metals grade (VDM Alloy 602 CA / Nicrofer 6025 HT). Often searched as "Inconel 602 CA", but Special Metals does not make it
- [Incoloy](https://www.nickelsheets.com/incoloy/): nickel-iron-chromium alloys — 330, 660 (A-286, UNS S66286), 800, 800H, 800HT, 825, 890, 903, 909, 925, 945
- [Monel](https://www.nickelsheets.com/monel/): nickel-copper alloys — 400, 405, K-500
- [Hastelloy](https://www.nickelsheets.com/hastelloy/): nickel-molybdenum/chromium alloys — B2, B3, C22, C276, C2000, C4, G30, N, X
- [Haynes](https://www.nickelsheets.com/haynes/): high-temperature alloys — 214, 230, 242, 282, HR-120, 25, 188
- [Nimonic](https://www.nickelsheets.com/nimonic/): 75, 80A, 81, 86, 90, 105, 115, 263, 901
- [Nichrome](https://www.nickelsheets.com/nichrome/): NiCr resistance alloys — 80/20, 70/30, 60/15, 40/20, 30/20, 20/25
- [Titanium](https://www.nickelsheets.com/titanium/): commercially pure and alloyed — Grades 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9, 11, 12, 16, 23
- [Stainless Steel](https://www.nickelsheets.com/stainless/): super-austenitic and special grades — 904L, AL-6XN, SMO 254, Alloy 20, 28, 31, 926, AM 350
- [Duplex Steel](https://www.nickelsheets.com/duplex-steel/): duplex and super duplex — 2205 (S31803 / S32205), 2507 (S32750), S32760
- [Cobalt Alloys](https://www.nickelsheets.com/cobalt-alloys/): Stellite, Elgiloy, cobalt-chrome
- [Pure Nickel Strips](https://www.nickelsheets.com/pure-nickel-strips/): Nickel 200/201 strip and busbar for battery packs
- [Nickel 200 / 201](https://www.nickelsheets.com/nickel-200-201/): commercially pure nickel
- [Invar](https://www.nickelsheets.com/invar/) and [Kovar](https://www.nickelsheets.com/kovar/): controlled-expansion alloys
- [Mu-Metal](https://www.nickelsheets.com/mu-metal/): magnetic shielding alloy
- [Nitinol](https://www.nickelsheets.com/nitinol/): shape-memory nickel-titanium
- [Waspaloy](https://www.nickelsheets.com/waspalloy/), [Stellite](https://www.nickelsheets.com/stellite/), [Elgiloy](https://www.nickelsheets.com/cobalt-alloys/elgiloy/)
